name: Single Arm High Row (Cable)
instructions: Set a cable pulley at about head height and hold the handle with one hand.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder, leading with your elbow.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A single-arm cable row from a high pulley.
